name: round3_latency
description: Family F only. ATTENDED - clumsy must be set by hand on the subscriber between levels. Run this separately, after the unattended campaign has finished. With latency_gate on, the orchestrator pauses before every level and waits for you to write the millisecond value into C:\r3\LATENCY_SET; it refuses to start a level on any other value, so a forgotten clumsy change cannot silently produce a clean-looking wrong level.
